description.en: A lightweight DSH plugin for persistent local WARN/ERROR logs in rotating JSONL files. Features bounded buffering, best-effort secret redaction, and automatic log retention. Zero runtime dependencies. Supports DSH on Windows x64.
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sidebar plugin: stack-safe fork tree, two-track indentation, marquee title, leading/hover slots, and cascade purge.
DSH web plugin (dsh-better-sidebar companion): export the current .md file to standalone HTML (Mermaid inlined) or PDF - export button on the markdown toolbar

VulcanCode plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): OpenVulcan account, Vulcan Decision permission guard, interactive answers, VulcanCode UI style and LuaSkills with the Hub. Community plugins, not affiliated with DeepSeek.
把 DSH 的模型输出改造成「豆包语」：超长排比 + 否定清单 + 疗愈诊断 + 复读共情 + 服务化收尾。双通道、三种模式、全部参数可在设置页调。
Single-client session tabs preserving native sidebars and background work

DeepSeek Harness skill bundle for HOI4 1.19.3 modding: focus trees, tech-tree UI, tank designer, 3D tank models, DDS icons, scripted GUI/topbar, CJK fonts, 14 bundled Python tools, a 23-workshop-mod survey and an agent-teams playbook. No game assets.
description.zh: 让 AI 变身 HOI4 模组开发者，帮你写国策、事件、决议和界面，还能校验并打包安装。

description.en: Inspect API latency, streaming output and model-response fingerprints from a native DSH panel, with classic-task previews and public benchmark rankings.
description.zh: 从 DSH 原生侧栏检查 API 连接、流式速度与模型指纹，浏览经典题作品和公开能力榜单。

description.en: One switch that routes the git, npm and pip commands DSH runs through a local HTTP proxy, restoring every previous setting when turned off.
description.zh: 一个开关，让 DSH 运行的 git、npm、pip 命令走本机代理，关闭时逐项还原原有设置。

description.en: Adds one system-prompt section that limits delegation to subagents and teammates to two cases: adversarial review of freshly produced output, and one-shot context reading that returns a summary.
description.zh: 添加一段系统提示词，把对子智能体和队友的委派限制在两种情况：对刚写出的产出做对抗性审查，以及只回传摘要的一次性大量阅读。

description.en: Named AGENTS.md presets for DSH: save instruction sets under $DSH_HOME/agents-md-presets, apply one to the current conversation workspace, edit bodies in your own editor, and keep one rolling backup of the file being overwritten.
description.zh: 为 DSH 维护多套具名 AGENTS.md 预设：正文存在 $DSH_HOME/agents-md-presets，在会话里选一套写入该会话工作区的 AGENTS.md，正文用本机编辑器修改，覆盖前把原文件留一份最近备份。

description.en: A wall of photographs hung behind the main panel - uneven sizes at their own angles with room to breathe, twenty real landscape photographs shipped to fill it on first run, up to twenty rotating images per frame, rectangles only, the three lowest frames playing a local video, and one shortcut that sends the video back into the rotation.
description.zh: 挂在主面板背后的一面照片墙：大小不一、各自倾斜、彼此留白。自带二十张真实风景照，首次启动就挂上墙；每个画框最多二十张图轮播，最下面三个框可以放本地视频，一个快捷键让视频退回照片轮播。

description.en: Translates the English text of DSH approval prompts and ask_user_question cards into Chinese for display only: approval outcomes, option labels, tool names and JSON arguments stay unchanged, and approval audit records keep the original English. The text is sent to Microsoft's Edge translation endpoint (edge.microsoft.com) to be translated, so the content of approval prompts and questions, including command text, leaves your machine.
description.zh: 把 DSH 审批提示和 ask_user_question 卡片里的英文说明翻成中文显示；审批结果、选项标签、工具名和 JSON 参数保持不变，审批审计记录里仍是英文原文。文本会发送到微软 Edge 翻译接口（edge.microsoft.com）翻译，所以审批提示和问题的内容（包括命令文本）会离开本机。

description.en: Confluence and Jira over Atlassian remote MCP as a configuration-only bundle: one MCP client row, OAuth handled by mcp-remote with the token cached in ~/.mcp-auth, no login command and no in-app UI. Exposes mcp__atlassian__* tools (CQL search, pages, comments, JQL issues, transitions).
description.zh: 以纯配置包的形式接入 Atlassian 远程 MCP，提供 Confluence 与 Jira：只加一行 MCP 客户端配置，OAuth 交给 mcp-remote、令牌缓存在 ~/.mcp-auth，没有登录命令也没有界面。工具名为 mcp__atlassian__*（CQL 搜索、页面、评论、JQL 问题、状态流转）。

description.en: Chat / work mode switch: chat conversations hide every tool, work mode reuses the conversation workspace.
description.zh: 聊天 / 工作模式开关：聊天模式隐藏全部工具，工作模式沿用该对话的工作区。

description.en: Makes a DeepSeek Harness agent reason in Simplified Chinese: each turn it appends one runtime-context instruction at the end of the conversation, and it can keep a stable declaration in the system prompt as well. Settings pick Simplified Chinese or off, and whether that declaration is included.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 用简体中文推理：每轮在对话末尾追加一条运行时上下文指令，并可选在系统提示词里保留一条稳定声明。设置里可选简体中文或关闭，并决定是否保留该声明。

description.en: Runs authenticated batches of DeepSeek Harness tasks from Codex on the same Windows computer.
description.zh: 通过本机认证桥接，在 Windows 上从 Codex 批量调用 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Skill manager for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: lists global and project-level skills with call counts, last-used dates and estimated context tokens, and archives or restores a skill by moving its directory into a reversible skill-archive next to the skills root.
description.zh: DSH 左侧栏「Skill 管理」：列出全局与项目级 skill 的调用次数、最近使用时间与估算占用 tokens，支持把 skill 目录移入同级可逆的 skill-archive 归档、以及一键还原。

description.en: Deletes the dsh-auth-* login cookies DSH Desktop appends on every launch, which otherwise pile up past the 16 KB request-header limit and make the app fail with HTTP 431.
description.zh: 清理 DSH 桌面端每次启动新增的 dsh-auth-* 登录 Cookie，避免累积超过 16KB 请求头上限后出现 HTTP 431、打不开。

description.en: Cost ledger tab for DSH: per-turn token accounting converted to CNY, stacked daily charts styled after the DeepSeek console, and a built-in Alibaba Bailian price book covering 142 models (Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax). Models no catalogue covers stay explicitly unpriced instead of being counted as zero, and a manual price fills them in with one click.
description.zh: 「费用」标签页：按天、按模型统计 token 花费并折算成人民币，堆叠柱状图对齐 DeepSeek 官方控制台，悬停即可看到当天每个模型花了多少；内置阿里百炼官方价目表 142 个模型（千问、DeepSeek、Kimi、GLM、MiniMax），缓存命中按官方 10% 规则计价；查不到价的模型明确标为「未定价」并可一键手填，绝不静默算成 0。

description.en: A life-care layer for DSH: health log and cycle care in every session, saved coordinates so nearby-place questions do not need re-asking, Amap and Luckin MCP tools, plus a QQ companion layer that injects expression rules into replies.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一层生活关怀：每个会话都带健康日志与周期关怀，面板里存过的常用坐标省掉「你在哪」的反问，高德与瑞幸的 MCP 工具挂进所有会话；另附 QQ 伴生层，把表达规则注入回复。

description.en: Before you say yes to an agent, ask how the code works: answers come with an interactive UML diagram (8 types) linked to the text, so pointing at a paragraph highlights it in the diagram and clicking a step jumps to its paragraph. Code quotes are checked against the files.
description.zh: 点 yes 之前先问清代码怎么运作：回答带一张和文字联动的交互式 UML 图（8 种），指向段落图上跟着高亮，点图里的一步文字跳到对应段落；代码引文回到文件里核对。

description.en: A fork of dougen/dsh-deepseek-usage (the upstream repository has no license file; its manifest declares MIT) that adds IKunCode account balance queries alongside the upstream provider readers, subscription usage windows and model price snapshots. For IKunCode, your key is sent as a Bearer token to api.ikuncode.cc. It installs as @elsebit/dsh-deepseek-usage-extended from GitHub Releases with its own routes and settings, so disable the original usage plugin if you want a single card; the OAuth credential references it inherits are shared with the original.
description.zh: dougen/dsh-deepseek-usage 的 fork（上游仓库没有许可证文件，manifest 声明 MIT），在上游的各家余额读取、订阅用量窗口和模型价格快照之外，增加 IKunCode 账户余额查询。查 IKunCode 时，你的密钥会以 Bearer 令牌发往 api.ikuncode.cc。它以 @elsebit/dsh-deepseek-usage-extended 的名字从 GitHub Release 安装，路由和设置独立，只想留一张用量卡片的话请停用原插件；继承来的 OAuth 凭据引用与原插件共用。

description.en: DSH Desktop toolkit with separate settings for each feature: a selection toolbar, a floating assistant, and screenshot, long screenshot and screen recording modes opened by global shortcuts from a toolbar at the top of the screen. Screenshots support shapes, pen, arrows, text and numbered markers, mosaic, pin to desktop, saving, and forwarding to a DSH conversation or the system share panel (Windows and macOS); recordings capture an area, a window or a full screen as MP4, GIF or WebM with optional system sound and microphone. Extract text, Translate and Knowledge graph on captures use the OCR tools of dsh-vision-router, which is installed separately (the settings page offers a one-click install). Requires DSH Desktop >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0. The features run in a separate Electron helper process and the plugin does not download Electron: with the installer build of DSH Desktop you must provide a standalone Electron through the electronExecutable setting, the DSH_DESKTOP_TOOLS_ELECTRON environment variable or $DSH_HOME/electron/; a DSH Desktop started from a bare Electron reuses it. System sound recording is not available on Linux.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端提供划词工具栏、悬浮球，以及通过全局快捷键唤起、在屏幕顶部工具栏切换的截图、长截图和录屏，每项功能独立设置。截图支持形状、画笔、箭头、文本与序号、马赛克、钉在桌面、保存，以及转发到 DSH 对话或系统分享面板（Windows 和 macOS）；录屏可录制区域、窗口或全屏，输出 MP4、GIF 或 WebM，可选录制系统声音和麦克风。截图的提取文字、翻译和知识图谱使用 dsh-vision-router 的 OCR 工具，该插件需另行安装（设置页提供一键安装）。需要 DSH Desktop >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0。各项功能运行在单独的 Electron 辅助进程中，插件不会下载 Electron：安装版 DSH Desktop 需另备独立 Electron，可通过插件设置 electronExecutable、环境变量 DSH_DESKTOP_TOOLS_ELECTRON 或 $DSH_HOME/electron/ 提供；由裸 Electron 启动的 DSH Desktop 会直接复用它。Linux 不支持录制系统声音。

description.en: Left sidebar disk panel for the DSH Web UI: volume free space, per-Workspace folder sizes, moving build artifacts to the macOS Trash with an audit log and restore, sending scan results to an agent, and a host-side low-space watchdog with OS notifications. macOS and Linux only; Trash cleanup works on macOS only, while Linux gets the scan, trend and watchdog without cleanup. Cleanup is limited to a fixed list of build-artifact folder names directly under a registered Workspace.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 左侧栏磁盘面板：各卷剩余空间、按工作区统计目录占用、把构建产物安全移入 macOS 废纸篓（带审计与恢复）、把扫描结果交给 Agent 分析，以及 Host 端低空间看门狗与系统通知。仅限 macOS 和 Linux；移入废纸篓只在 macOS 上可用，Linux 上有扫描、趋势和看门狗但没有清理。清理只限注册工作区根目录下一批固定名字的构建产物目录。

description.en: Blinks the DeepSeek Harness tray whale when a task finishes in the background, and keeps blinking until you switch back (Windows).
description.zh: 任务在后台完成时让 DeepSeek Harness 托盘的鲸鱼图标闪动，并且一直闪到你切回窗口为止（Windows）。

description.en: Douyin for DSH: bounded autonomous watching with storyboard frames and danmaku sampling, persona and interest memory, a daily watch report, plus direct-message auto-reply and one daily greeting for a whitelisted set of friends. This is a maintained fork of dafeiyu1314520/dsh-douyin-agent 1.4.7 that fixes follow-list read timeouts, unclickable conversations, missed replies, and greetings that stopped scheduling after a single send. Windows only (a dedicated Edge window, Node.js 22.13+). Replies and greetings are sent as ordinary messages with no “automated reply” label, and once you have enabled them they restart by themselves each time DSH launches until you stop them by hand. It registers the same bundle id as dafeiyu1314520/dsh-douyin-agent and LockyBee/dsh-douyin-agent, so it replaces them rather than running next to them.
description.zh: DSH 里的抖音：限时自主观看（抽帧故事板 + 弹幕采样）、人格与兴趣记忆、观看日报，并给许可名单里的好友自动回私信、每天问候一次。本条目是基于 dafeiyu1314520/dsh-douyin-agent 1.4.7 的维护分支，修掉了关注名单读取超时、会话点不开、漏回消息、问候发一条就停等问题。仅限 Windows（专用 Edge 窗口、Node.js 22.13+）。回复和问候以普通消息发出，不带“自动回复”标记；启用后每次 DSH 启动都会自动恢复，直到你手动停止。它和 dafeiyu1314520/dsh-douyin-agent、LockyBee/dsh-douyin-agent 注册同一个 bundle id，是替代而不是并装。

description.en: Download queue with aria2 and optional Xunlei engines, magnet links, and a per-session history; aria2 is not bundled and must be installed separately, and the Xunlei engine needs its own SDK and API key. Built mainly for Windows. Its POST routes (add, pause, remove downloads, with a caller-chosen target directory) are mounted with webServer.register and only check that the connection is from loopback, so a web page open in your browser can queue downloads on your behalf.
description.zh: 下载队列：aria2 与可选迅雷双引擎、磁力链接、按会话记录下载历史；aria2 不随包附带，需自行安装，迅雷引擎需自装 SDK 并提供 API Key；主要面向 Windows。它的 POST 路由（添加、暂停、删除下载，可指定保存目录）通过 webServer.register 挂载，只检查连接来自本机回环，所以浏览器里打开的任意网页都能替你加下载任务。

description.en: Lightweight cross-session reflection: at the end of each turn it writes 3-5 reusable facts (tool chain, file paths, config items, pitfalls) as a card in .dsh/reflections/{date}.md, and on a new session it injects the last 3 cards at the end of the system prompt. Extraction uses the real ctx.llm.stream; when no model route is available it falls back to a heuristic built only from the session log and labels the source honestly on the card. No timers, no quarantine, no approval flow; cards are plain Markdown you can edit or delete.
description.zh: 轻量级跨会话反思：每轮结束时把 3–5 条可复用事实（工具链、文件路径、配置项、踩过的坑）写成 .dsh/reflections/{日期}.md 卡片，新会话启动时自动把最近 3 张卡片注入系统提示词末尾。提炼走真实的 ctx.llm.stream，模型不可用时降级为只读会话日志的启发式提取，并在卡片上如实标注来源。没有定时器、隔离区和审批流；卡片是普通 Markdown，可直接编辑删除。

description.en: Adds a top-left Harness/Chat switcher and a web-chat workspace that drives your own logged-in chat.deepseek.com session in a persistent headless browser, with one-click task extraction to a Harness session and results sent back to the web chat. Starts a persistent Chrome or Edge profile with remote debugging on 127.0.0.1:9410 that keeps your chat.deepseek.com login; its /dual-mode routes have no DSH access check and can create Harness tasks from the web chat.
description.zh: 在左上角新增 Harness/Chat 双模式切换与网页对话工作区，通过持久化无头浏览器驱动你自己登录的 chat.deepseek.com，支持一键提取任务发送到 Harness 会话并把执行结果回传网页对话。会启动一个持久的 Chrome 或 Edge 配置，在 127.0.0.1:9410 开远程调试并保存你的 chat.deepseek.com 登录态；它的 /dual-mode 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，并且可以从网页聊天创建 Harness 任务。

description.en: Rotating word and phrase flashcards under the composer, plus a right-sidebar page with an English topic brief, topic-matched vocabulary and a word book.
description.zh: 输入框下方轮播单词与短语闪卡，右侧栏提供当前会话主题英文简报、主题词汇与生词本。

description.en: Track source lineage for web excerpts and structured Agent reports, fold repeated text with recorded provenance, and export auditable evidence through DSH tools.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 工具追踪网页摘录与结构化 Agent 汇报的来源关系，折叠有同源记录的重复正文，并导出可追溯证据。

description.en: Feishu/Lark channel that pushes finished or failed turns to a phone and delivers group messages back into the workspace session. Group messages are delivered into the session as user messages, so anyone who can post in a chat listed under task.chats can instruct the agent with that session's tool permissions; no chat is listed by default. The app secret is stored in plain text in ~/.dsh/feishu/app.json.
description.zh: 飞书/Lark 通道：把会话完成或出错的结果推到手机，并把群里的消息回投给工作区会话。群里的消息会作为用户消息投递进会话，所以能在 task.chats 所列群里发言的人都能以该会话的工具权限指挥 agent；默认没有列出任何群。应用密钥明文存放在 ~/.dsh/feishu/app.json。

description.en: Chinese tax and cross-border e-commerce workbench: a local BigInt statement parser for Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Stripe CSV/TSV/XLSX exports (fintax_parse_statement), a 7-scenario deterministic tax and reconciliation calculator (fintax_calc), 4 read-only Tencent IMA knowledge-base tools (ima_list_kbs, ima_browse, ima_search, ima_read), 4 bundled compliance skills, and an in-app settings section. Statement files are parsed locally; optional IMA credentials are read from environment variables or ~/.config/ima/ (write-only via authenticated /api/fintax routes, never echoed back) and sent only to ima.qq.com; zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 中国财税与跨境电商工作台：提供 Amazon、TikTok Shop、Stripe 原始结算账单本地 BigInt 离线解析与异常雷达工具（fintax_parse_statement）、7 场景确定性算税与四层口径差额桥接工具（fintax_calc）、4 个腾讯 IMA 知识库只读检索工具（ima_list_kbs、ima_browse、ima_search、ima_read）、4 项合规自查技能及内置设置面板。账单文件仅在本地离线解析；可选的 IMA 凭证从环境变量或 ~/.config/ima/ 读取（/api/fintax 路由逐请求经宿主 connection 准入校验，密钥只写不回传明文）并仅发送至官方 ima.qq.com；纯 ESM 零运行时依赖。

description.en: Password gate and reverse proxy for the DeepSeek Harness web interface.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的密码门与反向代理：默认只监听本机回环，没设置密码时首次启动会生成一个密码并只显示一次；需要远程访问时再把 listenHost 设为 0.0.0.0。

description.en: Adds read-only Git status colors, file badges and directory change summaries to the native DSH file tree, with cached status reads and a manual refresh button.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生文件树中显示只读 Git 状态颜色、文件标记和目录变更汇总，提供状态缓存及手动刷新按钮。

description.en: A DSH sidebar panel that talks to locally running Hermes TUI gateways over JSON-RPC: switch between bot profiles, resume their Bot Chat sessions, stream message and tool deltas, and embed the Hermes terminal view.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏面板通过 JSON-RPC 直连本机运行的 Hermes TUI Gateway：切换 Bot profile、恢复各自的 Bot Chat 会话、流式显示消息与工具增量，并可内嵌 Hermes 终端视图。

description.en: A personal home workspace with tasks, a focus timer, a Flomo notes timeline, shortcuts and wallpapers.
description.zh: 一页个人工作台：待办、专注计时、Flomo 笔记时间流、快捷入口与壁纸。

description.en: Generates DSH host-side plugin skeletons — tool registration, an approval hook, a dsh.bundle manifest and three test layers — and registers a plugin_kit_new tool so the agent can scaffold a plugin from inside DSH without a shell.
description.zh: 一条命令生成 DSH host 侧插件骨架（工具注册 + 审批钩子 + dsh.bundle 清单 + 三层测试），并注册 plugin_kit_new 工具，让 agent 不开 shell 也能在 DSH 里搭骨架。

description.en: Runs a complete HR workbench inside DSH — a 3D office, recruiting pipeline (resume, interview, written test, score), employee roster, files, attendance, performance, training and analytics — with the site’s AI assistant answering through the model DSH already runs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里跑一整套 HR 工作台——3D 办公室、招聘流水线（简历、面试、笔试、综合成绩）、员工花名册、文件柜、考勤、绩效、培训与人事分析——站内 AI 助手直接用 DSH 的模型回答。

description.en: Replaces native DSH file-tree file and folder icons with locally bundled vscode-icons artwork and filename associations, preserving native tree interactions and expanded folder states.
description.zh: 使用本地打包的 vscode-icons 图标和文件名映射替换 DSH 原生文件树的文件与文件夹图标，保留原生交互及文件夹展开状态。

description.en: Blurs every image in the conversation body until you click the Show button in its corner, leaving side panels, plugin pages and icons untouched.
description.zh: 对话正文里的图片默认模糊，点图片右上角的「显示」才看清；侧栏、面板与图标不受影响。

description.en: Cross-domain search and A-share data for DSH: arXiv, Crossref, GitHub, Hacker News, Hugging Face, Product Hunt, plus stock quotes, klines and announcements.
description.zh: DSH 的跨领域信息与 A 股工具：arXiv、Crossref、GitHub、Hacker News、Hugging Face、Product Hunt，以及行情、走势与公告。

description.en: A floating-island UI skin for DeepSeek Harness with a persistent left rail, an aggregate pinned-session section, and a configurable accent color.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设计的浮岛式界面皮肤，包含常驻左侧栏、置顶聚合与可调强调色。

description.en: P2P, end-to-end encrypted remote access to DeepSeek Harness, CodeX, Claude Code, Pi and other agent workspaces from web and mobile clients. Remote connections are coordinated through a hosted server (remote.gaolin.ink by default; you can point it at your own) and you sign in with an account there. It installs under the package name ds-harness-remote, the same as liguobao/ds-harness-remote, so install only one of them.
description.zh: 基于 P2P 网络与端到端加密，从手机、浏览器和电脑远程访问 DeepSeek Harness、CodeX、Claude Code、Pi 等工作区。远程连接经由托管服务器协调（默认 remote.gaolin.ink，可改成自建的），需要在那里登录账号。它以 ds-harness-remote 的包名安装，与 liguobao/ds-harness-remote 同名，只能装其中一个。

description.en: Local-first knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: workspace Markdown notes with provenance, review status, BM25 search, and four km_* tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地知识库：工作区 Markdown 笔记，带来源、审核状态、BM25 检索与 4 个 km_* 工具。

description.en: Off-peak scheduler for DeepSeek Harness: queue prompts to send automatically during DeepSeek off-peak hours, with peak/off-peak price fetching, low-balance alerts and a local usage ledger.
description.zh: DSH 谷价调度器：把写好的指令排在 DeepSeek Harness谷价时段自动发送，附带峰谷价格与时段抓取、余额提醒与本机用量记账。

description.en: Replaces the DSH startup screen with an ~18 s anime-style Link Start dive whose check, language, log-in and confirmation scenes show your own DSH status (profile, plugins, default model, workspaces, sessions, UI language). Click or press any key to skip; plays a gentle ~10 s version under reduced motion and lowers effect quality on slow machines. Unofficial fan work.
description.zh: 把 DSH 启动画面换成约 18 秒、动画风格的 Link Start 连线动画，检测、语言、登录和工作区确认几步显示你这台 DSH 的实际状态（profile、插件、默认模型、工作区、会话、界面语言）。点击或按任意键跳过；系统开启减少动态效果时播约 10 秒的平缓版，慢机器上自动降画质。非官方同人作品。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness sidebar for LiteLLM models, MCP servers, skills, and spend.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏面板，用于 LiteLLM 虚拟钥匙、动态模型注入、MCP 转发与花费统计。

description.en: Customize DeepSeek Harness branding — swap the sidebar and hero logos, rebuild the DeepSeek and Harness wordmark halves, edit the welcome headline, and toggle the preview badge.
description.zh: 替换 DeepSeek Harness 界面各处品牌元素——侧栏 Logo、品牌字标两半、对话页 Logo、欢迎语标语，预览版徽章开关。纯前端注入，不修改安装文件。

description.en: Unofficial Loomy (iFlytek) model provider: signs in with an SMS code or by adopting the Loomy desktop app session already on the machine, registers one provider route per account from the live per-account catalog, and renews the daily 5000 free credits on startup and at local midnight. Unofficial: the endpoints and the desktop client's own application key pair were reverse-engineered from the Loomy desktop app, and automated traffic may conflict with Loomy's account terms. On first start it silently imports the login the desktop app keeps in a plain-text auth-session.json (on Windows it scans every C:\Users\Public\Loomy\*\userData folder and takes the most recently updated session), keeps sessions in $DSH_HOME/dsh-loomy/accounts.json, claims the daily credits at startup and every local midnight, and sends chat requests to loomyad.xunfei.cn.
description.zh: 非官方 Loomy（讯飞）模型接入插件：用手机验证码登录，或直接复用本机 Loomy 桌面端已有的登录态；按账号实时拉取模型目录并注册独立路由；启动时与本地零点自动续领每日赠送的 5000 积分。非官方：接口和桌面端自带的应用密钥对都是从 Loomy 桌面端逆向得来，自动化流量可能与 Loomy 的账号条款冲突。首次启动会静默导入桌面端以明文保存在 auth-session.json 里的登录（Windows 上会扫描 C:\Users\Public\Loomy\*\userData 下所有目录，取最近更新的会话），会话存在 $DSH_HOME/dsh-loomy/accounts.json，启动时和每个本地零点领取每日积分，对话请求发往 loomyad.xunfei.cn。

description.en: Shows a Kobe iced-tea side popup and reports per-turn costs or token counts with bundled offline audio. Uses dsh-cost-meter first, or estimates each request from native usage and public prices. Includes twenty cost phrases, four token phrases, CNY/USD, three-decimal rounding and custom previews; no runtime TTS service or API key. The bundled voice clips are pre-synthesized offline and the portrait is a fan-made image; the package declares UNLICENSED. When it has to estimate a cost itself it fetches a public price table from raw.githubusercontent.com (Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter) and the USD/CNY rate from open.er-api.com, at most once a day, and sends no session data.
description.zh: 每轮结束弹出科比冰红茶人物，离线播报本轮费用或 Token 用量；费用优先使用 dsh-cost-meter，不可用时按各请求原生用量与公开单价估算并标明来源。含二十句金额台词、四句 Token 台词，支持人民币/美元、三位小数四舍五入及自定义试听；无需在线语音服务或 API Key。内置的语音片段是预先合成的离线音频，人物图是网络二创图；包的许可证声明为 UNLICENSED。需要自己估算费用时，它最多每天一次从 raw.githubusercontent.com（Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter）取公开价格表、从 open.er-api.com 取美元兑人民币汇率，不发送会话数据。

description.en: Adds a Markdown outline and full-reply search to conversations, with section references, reversible turn hiding, and new sessions from selected turns.
description.zh: 为会话提供 Markdown 目录与回复全文搜索，支持章节引用、可逆隐藏轮次及从所选轮次创建新会话。

description.en: China Mobile Cloud Drive (139) inside DSH: browse, upload, download and move files, plus 12 model tools. Its /api/dsh-mcloud routes (sign-in, list, download, move, delete) are mounted with webServer.register without DSH Host/Origin admission, so a web page open in your browser can act on the signed-in cloud drive through them.
description.zh: 中国移动云盘（139）接入 DSH：浏览、上传、下载、转移网盘文件，并提供 12 个模型工具。它的 /api/dsh-mcloud 路由（登录、列目录、下载、移动、删除）通过 webServer.register 挂载，没有 DSH 的 Host/Origin 准入检查，所以浏览器里打开的任意网页都能经由它们操作已登录的云盘。

description.en: Manage memory files written by DSH memory plugins inside Settings (view/edit/delete), and sync them to one cloud drive with conflict-safe three-way sync; other drives take upload-only backups.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里查看、编辑、删除各记忆插件写下的记忆文件，并同步到一个网盘（冲突安全的三方同步）；其他网盘只做上传备份。

description.en: Port of MiMo Code's infinite-context memory: as the window fills it asks the model in the background (the current provider route unless writerProvider/writerModel is set) to write a structured checkpoint and a project MEMORY.md, then, ahead of DSH's native compaction, replaces the visible window with a rebuilt dump of tasks, checkpoint, recent user messages, memory and notes, falling back to a MiMo-style compaction. Memory files live under $DSH_HOME/mimo-context (per session, per project, plus a read-only global one); it adds mimo_* memory, history, checkpoint and rebuild tools and /mimo-* commands, with dream/distill off by default. Needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or a later 0.2.x.
description.zh: 移植自 MiMo Code 的无限上下文记忆：窗口逐渐填满时，在后台让模型（默认沿用当前模型路由，可用 writerProvider/writerModel 指定）写出结构化 checkpoint 和项目 MEMORY.md，并在 DSH 原生 compaction 之前，用任务、checkpoint、最近用户消息、记忆与笔记重建的内容替换当前可见窗口，没有可用 checkpoint 时回退到 MiMo 式压缩。记忆文件存在 $DSH_HOME/mimo-context（按会话、按项目，另有只读的全局记忆）；提供 mimo_* 记忆、历史、checkpoint、重建工具和 /mimo-* 命令，dream/distill 默认关闭。需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 或之后的 0.2.x。

description.en: Moonlight theme: cool-white light and navy dark palettes, rounded Latin type in light mode, assistant replies in bubbles or plain flow, minimal sidebar chrome, stepless body and sidebar ink weight, a 4-12 character sidebar title cap, and optional idle timestamps. Clicking the 工作区 label reveals archived sessions; Up/Down step through sessions.
description.zh: 月光主题：冷白浅色与海军蓝深色两套配色，浅色下用圆润拉丁字体，助手回复可选气泡或平铺，侧栏可精简，正文与侧栏字重各自无级可调，侧栏标题长度 4–12 字可调，空闲时间戳可隐藏；点侧栏「工作区」展开已归档会话，上下方向键切换会话。

description.en: Sidebar file tree that covers the session workspace root together with every additional root registered through multi-root-workspace, so sibling checkouts are browsable from one tab. Directory levels load lazily, changed and untracked files carry Git markers, and clicking a file opens its content inline beside the tree. Read-only: it never writes, renames or deletes anything. Needs the dsh-better-sidebar plugin, which serves the directory listings; its own routes (roots, git status/diff, image preview) take absolute paths from the page and have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 侧栏文件树，把会话主目录与 multi-root-workspace 登记的每个附加根放在一起浏览：平级仓库在同一个页签里都能看，目录按需懒加载，改动和未跟踪文件带 Git 标记，点文件在树旁边直接内联预览。纯只读，不会写入、重命名或删除任何文件。需要 dsh-better-sidebar 插件（目录列表走它的路由）；插件自己的路由（根列表、git 状态/diff、图片预览）直接接收页面传来的绝对路径，没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: NanoGPT PRO subscription models for DeepSeek Harness: a curated model picker with ×1/×2 rate badges, reasoning levels and the remaining weekly quota, without spending the subscription allowance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 NanoGPT PRO 订阅模型：精选的模型选择器，带 ×1/×2 倍率标记、推理档位和本周剩余额度，且不消耗订阅额度。

description.en: Adds up to 3 clickable next-action chips under a reply; clicking one fills the input draft and never sends.
description.zh: 在回复下方给出至多 3 条可点击的下一步建议；点击只填入输入框，不会自动发送。

description.en: Hold right-Cmd and talk — local SenseVoice STT, a fixed DSH session with voice-triggered rotation, and streaming CosyVoice2 TTS with emotion voices and an optional Live2D overlay.
description.zh: 按住右⌘说一句——本地 SenseVoice 识别、固定 DSH 会话（语音/按钮开新会话）、CosyVoice2 流式播报与情感音色，可选 Live2D 鲸鱼娘悬浮窗。

description.en: Adds a notepad to the DSH Web UI that floats as an edge-snapping, resizable card or docks into the real bottom layout row, switchable at runtime with shared text and images; notes auto-save (text in localStorage, images in IndexedDB) and follow the active theme.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面加一个记事本：可悬浮为四边吸附、可调尺寸的卡片，也可停靠进真实底栏布局行，两种模式随时切换并共享文字和图片；内容自动保存（文字存 localStorage，图片存 IndexedDB），跟随当前主题。

description.en: Writes engineering decisions down the way DSH documents its own — every non-trivial change leaves a Markdown note under .agents/notes/<lifecycle>/<class>/ holding the problem, the decision, the rejected alternatives and the consequences, committed to git and reviewable like code. It supplies the workflow for that: five tools (note_search, note_read, note_write, note_verify, note_skip), an end-of-turn hook that asks a code-changing turn to either write a note or record an explicit skip, the tree/format/archived checks, and the write-notes-like-deepseek skill bundled in the package and mounted by the plugin. A sidebar board that renders the notes into four views (architecture baseline, timeline, rejected proposals, decision list) comes with it; the notes themselves stay plain Markdown.
description.zh: 像 DSH 记录自己的决定那样记录工程决策：每次非平凡改动在 .agents/notes/<lifecycle>/<class>/ 下留一篇 Markdown，写清问题、决定、被否决的备选与后果，进 git、可以像代码一样 review。插件提供这套流程：note_search、note_read、note_write、note_verify、note_skip 五个工具，回合末钩子（改过代码的轮次要写笔记或记录一次显式跳过），树、格式、归档三项校验，以及随包分发、由插件挂载的 write-notes-like-deepseek 技能。另附把这些笔记渲染成四个视图（架构基线、演进时间线、避坑智库、决策清单）的侧边栏看板；笔记本体仍是普通 Markdown。

description.en: Shows a Windows toast notification when a DeepSeek Harness run finishes, a tool approval is requested, or a question is waiting for an answer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 任务跑完、需要批准工具调用或等你回答问题的时候，弹出 Windows 系统通知。

description.en: Long-form fiction workflow for DSH: seven queryable bibles, edit-impact tracking, living relationship and plot maps, and a first-chapter tryout that picks your writer. Its /novel-panel routes, including save, archive and reconcile, are mounted with webServer.register and carry no DSH Host/Origin admission check, so a web page open in your browser can write to the novel project through them.
description.zh: 长篇小说创作工作流：七份可查账的设定库、改稿影响追踪、活的图谱，以及用试笔稿选写手的机制。它的 /novel-panel 路由（含保存、归档、对账）通过 webServer.register 挂载，没有 DSH 的 Host/Origin 准入检查，所以浏览器里打开的任意网页都能经由它们写入小说项目。

description.en: Read and write your Obsidian vault from any conversation in DeepSeek Harness: daily notes, project notes, full-text search, and task check-off.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 任意对话里读写你的 Obsidian 笔记库：日记、项目笔记、全文搜索、任务勾选。

description.en: Windows desktop companion: installs and launches a semi-transparent, always-on-top off-work countdown widget. It counts down to the configured end time, keeps counting overtime, shows rest days, remembers its position and opacity, and provides a tray menu plus Ctrl+Alt+D click-through. Windows 10/11 x64 only; the widget is a separate desktop process, not a Harness page panel. The bundled OffWorkCountdown.exe is an unsigned prebuilt .NET Framework 4.8 binary (source in source.zip) that the plugin starts when DSH loads and stops on unload. It uses the same package name as wungjyan/dsh-offwork-countdown and ZydFirst/dsh-offwork-countdown, so only one of the three can be installed in a profile.
description.zh: Windows 桌面伴随插件：安装后启动一个半透明、始终置顶的下班倒计时小窗。支持上下班时间、加班计时、周末休息、位置与透明度记忆、托盘菜单和 Ctrl+Alt+D 鼠标穿透；仅支持 64 位 Windows 10/11。小窗是独立的桌面进程，不是 Harness 页面内的面板。随包的 OffWorkCountdown.exe 是未签名的预构建 .NET Framework 4.8 程序（源码在 source.zip），插件在 DSH 加载时启动它、卸载时停止。与 wungjyan/dsh-offwork-countdown、ZydFirst/dsh-offwork-countdown 同包名，同一个 profile 里三者只能装一个。

description.en: A cached daily scene, real weather, schedule and outfit for dsh conversation agents, with three ootd_* tools and the /ootd command.
description.zh: 为 dsh 对话角色提供按天缓存的日常场景、实况天气、日程与着装，并提供三个 ootd_* 工具和 /ootd 命令。

description.en: Runtime monitor for the plugins installed in a DSH profile: the panel lists every bundle and plugin entry with its Cordis fiber state and load diagnostics, scores risk from failed entries, missing bundles, version exemptions, install scripts, bin entries, a missing license and non-registry sources, keeps a timeline of state changes, and can disable a plugin entry or a whole bundle without leaving the panel.
description.zh: 监控 DSH 配置里已安装插件的运行时面板：列出每个 bundle 与插件条目及其 Cordis fiber 状态与加载诊断，依据条目失败、bundle 缺失、版本豁免、安装脚本、bin 入口、缺失许可证与非注册表来源计算风险分，记录状态变化时间线，并可在面板内停用某个插件条目或整个 bundle。

description.en: Fork of shaobeichen/dsh-pocket for remote phone access to the DSH Web UI: QR-code access over LAN or a cloudflared tunnel with live sync; mobile layout is left to DSH itself, the plugin adds safe-area and touch chrome, soft-keyboard Enter inserts a newline while hardware keyboards send on Enter, and install/update is left to the plugin manager. The command-line mode listens on 0.0.0.0 by default so a phone on the same Wi-Fi can scan the QR code; it generates an access password (embedded in the QR code) unless you pass --no-auth, and a cloudflared tunnel exposes the Web UI beyond your LAN.
description.zh: shaobeichen/dsh-pocket 的 fork：手机扫码经局域网或 cloudflared 隧道远程访问 DSH Web 界面并实时同屏；移动端布局交还 DSH 官方，插件只补安全区与触控样式，软键盘回车换行、外接键盘回车发送，安装与更新交给插件管理器。命令行模式默认监听 0.0.0.0，好让同一 Wi-Fi 下的手机扫码；除非加 --no-auth，否则会生成访问密码（嵌在二维码里）；cloudflared 隧道会把 Web 界面暴露到局域网之外。

description.en: Project workbench for DSH: groups sessions by project (workspace) in a panel with project cards and session lists, applies a project's default preset, model and reasoning effort to new sessions, scopes memory per project on request, previews AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md read-only, and groups the sidebar by project at startup.
description.zh: DSH 项目工作台：按项目（工作区）组织会话，提供项目卡片与会话列表；新建会话自动套用该项目的默认 preset、模型与推理强度；可按项目隔离记忆；只读预览 AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md；启动时把侧栏切为按项目分组。

description.en: Polishes the composer draft: opening the panel optimizes once with the default template, replacing the draft shows a line-by-line diff first, and a 9-second undo sits on the entry pill. Five templates (basics, structure, examples, reasoning, iteration) switch without spending a call; history and version chains stay on this machine, and the UI follows the Harness language.
description.zh: 输入框旁的提示词优化器：打开面板即按默认模板优化一次，替换草稿前先给逐行 diff，替换后 9 秒内可撤销。五种模板（基础 / 结构 / 示范 / 推理 / 迭代）换选择不计费，历史与版本链存在本机，界面跟随 Harness 语言切换。

description.en: Turns the QQ groups you follow into a Chinese daily digest. Pulls chat history through a local NapCat/OneBot 11 service into SQLite, summarizes each group, and renders an HTML/Markdown report with an opportunity radar that surfaces repeated complaints, tool requests and unmet needs as product ideas; can push a card to Feishu on a schedule.
description.zh: 把关注的 QQ 群聊总结成中文日报。经本机 NapCat/OneBot 11 拉取历史消息存入 SQLite，逐群摘要，生成带「机会雷达」的 HTML/Markdown 报告（从抱怨、求工具、求助里找产品机会），并可按计划推送到飞书。

description.en: QwenWork (千问办公) model provider for dsh: signs in through the desktop device flow and then calls the official OpenAI-compatible gateway, so tool calls, image input and usage pass through; adds the tiers of the plan as a qwenwork provider, keeps the credential in a local file that a refresh rewrites in place, and shows the remaining credits of the account.
description.zh: 把千问办公（QwenWork）接成 dsh 的模型提供方：用桌面端设备码登录，直连官方 OpenAI 兼容网关，工具调用、图片输入和 usage 都能透传；在 qwenwork 下提供套餐里的各档模型，凭据落在本地文件、到期自动刷新写回，并显示账号剩余积分。

description.en: Research-style problem solving in four gated stages: record sources by retrieval tier with local before web, turn each shortfall of existing tools into a gap that needs evidence, score candidates against weighted metrics with a deterministic engine, fuse or improve the weak ones, then iterate on measured deltas. Also organizes a directory into human-facing and machine-facing trees.
description.zh: 把解题当论文做：资料按检索阶梯登记（先本地后联网），别人的不足必须挂证据成为 gap，方案按加权指标交给确定性评分引擎打分，针对短板融合改进后用量化增量迭代；另附目录治理，把文件分成给人用与给 AI 用的两棵树。

description.en: Guides RTL design and verification in DeepSeek Harness, with project scaffolding, evidence checks, and OpenROAD/ORFS setup.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 RTL 设计与验证指导、工程脚手架、证据核对和 OpenROAD/ORFS 环境准备。

description.en: Adds four tools that query a local SAG Wiki index through the installed SAG CLI: semantic search, exact or regex match, and index status or update. Needs the SAG CLI on PATH, and semantic search also needs a JEV model configured in SAG; the model chooses which directory to index or drop (default: the session working directory).
description.zh: 通过本机 SAG CLI 提供四个工具查询 SAG Wiki 本地索引：语义检索、精确或正则匹配，以及索引状态查询与增删。需要 SAG CLI 在 PATH 里，语义检索还要在 SAG 里配好 JEV 模型；索引或移除哪个目录由模型决定（默认是会话工作目录）。

description.en: Cross-Workspace Memory: local-first, encrypted, per-session authorized memory for DSH.
description.zh: 跨工作区安全记忆：本地优先、加密的 DSH 跨工作区记忆插件，具备逐会话授权与提示词注入隔离功能。

description.en: Windows selection overlay for DSH that explains, summarizes or translates the selected text in any app; answers render in a native always-on-top panel with LaTeX formula support, multiple panels can stay open, and each can be folded or minimized to the taskbar.
description.zh: Windows 划词浮窗：在任意应用里选中文字后解释、总结或翻译，答案落在原生置顶浮窗里，支持 LaTeX 公式渲染、多窗口并存、折叠与最小化到任务栏。

description.en: Session manager panel for DSH: checks the three session stores (session dirs, metadata cache, workspace index), backs up before deleting, manages archive/restore, and runs a workspace health check with the workspace-doctor libs.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理面板：校验会话目录 / 元数据缓存 / 工作区索引三处存储的一致性，删除前恒先备份，支持归档恢复，并借助 workspace-doctor 库做工作区体检。

description.en: Sidebar tab with every file this conversation produced — preview images, PDF, Markdown, CSV and code in place, and jump back to the turn that made it.
description.zh: 侧边栏列出本会话产出的每个文件：就地预览图片、PDF、Markdown、CSV 与代码，并可跳回产出它的那一轮对话。

description.en: Adds a recoverable delete to the session context menu: the Host archives the session, detaches it from its project and moves the session directory plus the Markdown files that session wrote into $DSH_HOME/session-trash; a session with running work is refused.
description.zh: 在会话右键菜单加入可恢复的“删除会话”：归档会话、解除项目归属，并把会话目录连同该会话写过的 Markdown 文件移入 $DSH_HOME/session-trash；有运行中任务的会话会被拒绝。

description.en: Permanently delete DSH session records from the sidebar context menu, removing the session log directory, the projection cache entry and the workspace registration in one action. A confirmation dialog guards every delete. Its /dsh-session-purger routes, including permanent delete, are mounted with webServer.register and carry no DSH Host/Origin admission check, so a web page open in your browser can delete session records through them.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话右键菜单里彻底删除会话记录，一次清除会话日志目录、投影缓存与工作区登记；删除前有二次确认对话框。它的 /dsh-session-purger 路由（含永久删除）通过 webServer.register 挂载，没有 DSH 的 Host/Origin 准入检查，所以浏览器里打开的任意网页都能经由它们删除会话记录。

description.en: macOS only. Shows a live badge in DSH and an optional SwiftBar menu-bar item reporting what the Yunshu (Eagleyun SASE) endpoint agent is doing on this Mac right now — TCC permission requests, its own agent logs (screen capture, clipboard, browser URL reads, browser window counts), DLP scan paths and the process table. Read-only: it never blocks, disables or modifies the agent, keeps the last 60 events in memory only, writes three state files locally and makes no network calls. Requires the Yunshu agent to be installed; SwiftBar is optional.
description.zh: 仅 macOS。在 DSH 顶栏和可选的 SwiftBar 菜单栏显示云枢（Yunshu / 鹰云 SASE）终端 agent 此刻在本机做什么：TCC 权限申请、云枢自身日志（截屏、剪贴板读写、读取前台浏览器地址、各浏览器窗口数）、DLP 扫描的文件路径、进程表。纯只读——不拦截、不禁用、不修改云枢，只在内存保留最近 60 条动作，本地写三个状态文件，不联网。需要本机已安装云枢；SwiftBar 可选，不装也能用。

description.en: Adds sidebar collapse, a 248px compact mode, and panel-list folding to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏加上收起/展开、248px 紧凑模式与面板列表折叠。

description.en: Sidebar and conversation top-bar menu editor for DSH web: reorder, group, hide and re-icon entries (drag and drop, group flyouts, custom SVG or uploaded icons), reserves a configurable minimum height for the workspace tree, and exposes window.__dshSidebarManager for agents.
description.zh: DSH Web 的侧边栏与对话顶栏菜单编辑器：排序、分组、隐藏、逐条换图标（支持拖拽、分组浮层、SVG 或上传图标），为工作区树保留可配置的保底高度，并暴露 window.__dshSidebarManager 供 Agent 调用。

description.en: Browses and edits the skills directory in a VSCode-style file tree and editor panel in the DSH web client sidebar: creates, renames and deletes files and directories, reads and saves text files under size caps, and switches the served root directory from the panel (persisted through the profile config editor).
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 客户端侧边栏里用 VSCode 风格的文件树与编辑器面板浏览和编辑技能目录：新建、重命名、删除文件与目录，在大小上限内读写文本文件，并可在面板内切换所服务的根目录（通过 profile 配置编辑器持久化）。

description.en: Home Assistant control for DSH: entity states, history, service calls, notifications, weather, and a live home dashboard card.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里控制 Home Assistant：实体状态、历史、服务调用、通知、天气与实时家庭仪表盘卡片。

description.en: A DSH context-compaction plugin: when the route supports images, it renders the middle of a session history into locally generated 1-bit bitmap frames for the vision model, while the exact head and tail, a bounded exact-token index and a FILES index stay as text.
description.zh: DSH 上下文压缩插件：路由支持图片时，把会话历史的中段在本地渲染成单色位图帧交给视觉模型阅读；精确的首尾文本、有上限的精确 token 索引与 FILES 文件索引仍以文字保留。

description.en: Sidebar badge showing the current DeepSeek peak/off-peak billing phase, the countdown to the next switch, the account balance and a 7-day CNY spend chart — with a voice alarm when off-peak starts.
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示当前峰谷计费档位、切换倒计时、账户余额和近 7 天人民币花费柱状图；谷时开始时用语音提醒你开工。

description.en: Disk, CPU/memory/GPU, listening-port and token-usage cards with a full-page zoom; runs as a workbench module or standalone. The port card works on Windows only and the GPU card needs nvidia-smi.
description.zh: 磁盘、CPU/内存/GPU、监听端口与会话用量四张卡片，可放大到整页；既可作工作台模块，也能独立运行。端口卡片仅支持 Windows，GPU 卡片需要 nvidia-smi。

description.en: Three neon palettes for DeepSeek Harness — cyan, pink and yellow — picked from a Theme colors row of three swatches under Appearance in Settings → General, each palette carrying its own light and dark token set; the built-in Appearance switch still owns dark and light.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的三套霓虹配色——青、粉、黄，在「设置 → 通用设置」的「外观」下面一行三个色块里点选切换，每套配色各自带明暗两套 token；深浅仍由内置的「外观」开关决定。

description.en: Floating glass to-do card for the Harness Web UI with drag placement, resize, hide/show, four status views and an Eisenhower four-quadrant mode.
description.zh: Harness 界面上的毛玻璃待办卡片：可拖动、可缩放、可收起，支持四个状态视图与艾森豪威尔四象限模式。

description.en: Project board in the sidebar: a self-contained HTML Kanban and Gantt page served over a same-origin route, drag-and-drop columns, due-date timeline, JSON import/export, data kept in local storage.
description.zh: 侧栏项目看板：同源路由托管的单文件 HTML 看板与甘特图，卡片可拖拽换列、按截止日期排时间轴，支持 JSON 导入导出，数据只存本机。

description.en: Bilingual PDF paper reader: translates papers paragraph by paragraph in place, with compare view, paper Q&A, resumable translation and PDF export.
description.zh: 双语论文阅读插件：按原段落位置逐段翻译 PDF 论文，支持对照阅读、论文问答、断点续译与导出。

description.en: Sidebar widget that follows the session's current service and shows its plan quota or balance — OpenCode GO rolling, weekly and monthly windows with time bars, MiniMax usage, and DeepSeek, OpenRouter or Moonshot balances.
description.zh: 跟随会话当前服务的侧边栏小组件：显示 OpenCode GO 滚动、周、月用量与时间条，MiniMax 用量，以及 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Moonshot 余额。

description.en: Standalone usage statistics panel for DSH, derived from HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel by HaoyueQin (MIT): per-session breakdowns with model drill-down, per-row cache hit rates, an all-time range and CSV export.
description.zh: 独立的 DSH 用量统计面板，改自 HaoyueQin 的 dsh-usage-statistics-panel（MIT）：按会话拆分并可下钻模型、逐行缓存命中率、「全部」时间范围与 CSV 导出。

description.en: Composer-side helpers for the DSH Web UI: next-message prediction shown as grey ghost text that Tab fills in, a one-line per-turn recap above the input (placeable below instead) that never enters the model context, a right-sidebar panel for follow-ups from past sessions, recap history and side questions with their own model picker, and config-driven reply length, style and actionable framing.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的一组顺手小件：输入框下方灰字预测下一句、Tab 填入；输入框上方逐轮一行摘要（也可以放到下方）、不进入模型上下文；右侧栏面板管待跟进、会话回顾与旁问，旁问可单独选模型；回复长度、风格与「便于行动」也在插件配置里调。

description.en: A floating whale-girl pet for DeepSeek Harness that shows the live account balance and per-minute token spend.
description.zh: 一只显示 DeepSeek 余额和 token 每分钟花费的小鲸桌宠。

description.en: Workspace-scoped DSH migration: package a project's conversations, files and attachments, restore them on another machine into a chosen root with historical absolute paths rewritten, and re-sync only what changed afterwards.
description.zh: 按工作区迁移 DSH：把一个项目的会话、文件与附件打包，在新机器上还原到指定根目录并重写历史绝对路径，之后只增量同步改动的文件。

description.en: ZenTao workbench for DSH: load a ZenTao browse-page URL into a panel, multi-select bugs, tasks and stories, and hand them to the current or a new session with description, recent comments, screenshots as real image attachments and other files saved locally; when the agent is done it writes comments and status transitions (resolve, close, activate, start, finish and so on) back into ZenTao, one item or a batch, from the panel or through five registered agent tools (bug write-back verified end to end, task and story forms share the same code path).
description.zh: DSH 侧栏禅道工作台：粘贴禅道浏览页链接读取 Bug/任务/需求，多选后交给当前或新会话（带入描述、最近动态、截图转真实图片附件、其它附件落盘可读），AI 处理完把备注与状态（已解决、已关闭、重新激活、开始、完成等）单条或批量回写禅道，面板与 5 个 Agent 工具都能写；Bug 的备注与状态回写已实测通过，任务与需求表单走同一套代码路径。

description.en: A full-viewport donkey-mill background for the DSH Web UI: an animated top-down donkey or a Chinese-character form circles the millstone, accelerating with the model's live token throughput and plodding slowly when idle; a bottom-right panel switches form, adjusts opacity and hides the scene, persisting in localStorage.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的全屏驴拉磨背景：俯视动画驴或汉字形态绕磨盘转动，转速随模型实时 token 吞吐加快、空闲时缓慢踱步；右下角面板可切换形态、调节透明度、隐藏背景，设置保存在 localStorage。

description.en: Share selected theme settings, installed plugins and skills by QR code, then review and install them together from an image or screenshot. The QR code carries the install manifest only; larger skill and plugin files are downloaded from the sources it names, so a code from someone else makes your Harness fetch and install from their source.
description.zh: 将所选主题配置、已安装插件与 Skill 的安装信息写入二维码，接收者识别图片或截图后即可查看清单、一键安装，复用分享者的配置。二维码只带安装清单；较大的技能和插件文件会从清单指定的来源下载，所以别人发来的二维码会让你的 Harness 从对方指定的来源获取并安装。

description.en: A Windows Harness adaptation of [Media Review Skill](https://github.com/Ww-Cooooo/media-review) for AI video feedback: annotate frame regions or time ranges and jump to recognized speech or imported subtitle cues; other Agents with local file and command access can use the original Skill. Windows only and built for DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 (a 0.1.0 release candidate). Waveforms use an existing FFmpeg/ffprobe and transcripts an existing Whisper; without them, manual annotation and subtitle import still work.
description.zh: 让 AI 视频改稿反馈更直接：框选画面、拖选时间段或定格写意见，点击识别台词或导入字幕定位；基于 [Media Review Skill](https://github.com/Ww-Cooooo/media-review) 改造的 Windows Harness 插件，其他支持本机文件访问与命令执行的 Agent 可用原版 Skill。仅限 Windows，适配 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1（0.1.0 预发布版）。波形用本机已有的 FFmpeg / ffprobe，语音识别用已有的 Whisper；缺少时仍可手动标注和导入字幕。

description.en: Session alerts, safe deletion of archived sessions (optionally to the Recycle Bin), batch cleanup, and leftover-file cleanup for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供会话提醒、归档会话的安全删除（可选移入回收站）、批量清理和遗留文件清理。

description.en: Renders an SVG with CSS, SMIL or keyframe animation into a deterministic animated GIF, MP4 or WebM, exposing one DSH tool for frame-accurate loops and diagrams.
description.zh: 把带 CSS、SMIL 或关键帧的 SVG 渲染为确定性的 GIF、MP4 或 WebM，并提供一个 DSH 工具用于逐帧精确的循环动画与图表。

description.en: Colour-theme and wallpaper plugin: 62 colour themes (37 built-in, derived from OpenCode palettes, plus 25 IP presets), each shipping its own Markdown and syntax-highlight palette, a layer that pushes sub-4.5:1 semantic colours back to readable contrast, and local background images with fill or tile, blur, scrim and rotation. Replaces the earlier cnhenaihui/dsh-ios-theme.
description.zh: 配色主题与壁纸插件：62 套配色主题（37 套内置、源自 OpenCode 调色板，另有 25 套 IP 预设），每套自带 Markdown 与语法高亮配色，另有一层把低于 4.5:1 的语义色推回可读对比度，并支持本地背景图（铺满或平铺、模糊、遮罩、轮换）。取代此前的 cnhenaihui/dsh-ios-theme。

description.en: Fully background browser automation and browser use for DSH: an offscreen Electron window per conversation with real CDP input and screenshots, so headless-style browsing never steals focus or pops windows. Runs on Electron and keeps cookies in a persistent user-data directory, so a signed-in page stays signed in for later conversations.
description.zh: 完全后台静默运行的浏览器自动化：每个对话一个离屏浏览器窗口，提供真实 CDP 输入与截图，像 headless 一样工作却不抢焦点、不弹窗。基于 Electron 运行，cookie 保存在持久化的用户数据目录里，登录过的页面在之后的会话里仍保持登录。
在侧边栏统一管理 LiteLLM 网关、模型和技能，不用再改 YAML，开关即生效。
